query: SELECT via AS "via?" FROM (SELECT actor,action,fields,at,via FROM activity WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND entity_id=$2 ORDER BY at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1) latest WHERE actor=$3 AND action='update_issue' AND fields='["description"]'::jsonb AND at>$4 AND via IS NOT DISTINCT FROM nullif(current_setting('blackwall.via',true),'')::jsonb
